descriptionEn: Offered for rent: an apartment with an area of 60m², located on Rruga Abdyl Frashëri, in Aktash.

The apartment is on the 2nd floor and is fully equipped for living. It has a complete kitchen with dishes, glasses, a microwave, a dishwasher and a washing machine, together with the other appliances needed for everyday life.
The rent also includes the building maintenance, including the elevator and the cleaning of the common areas.
